newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Cornick buys stake in office furniture firm.
newsitem.headline: Cornick buys stake in office furniture firm.

text.p: Furniture group Pat Cornick Ltd said on Monday it had acquired a 70 percent interest in Grant Andrews Office Furniture for 15.38 million rand.

It said the deal would be settled by a 2.96 million rand cash payment, the issue and allotment of 365,957 linked units in Pat Cornick at an issue price of 23.00 rand and a further four million rand in cash, subject to adjustment in terms of a performance warranty for the 12 months to August 31.
Pat Cornick said the acquisition was in line with its strategy to apply its skills and systems in furniture related sectors focusing on niche markets.
